## Design

### 2026-10-11 – So im going to be honest with you, I was kind of lost for the majority of the week because I did not know what to make, but I was hovering around three different ideas.

**3h**

So im going to be honest with you, I was kind of lost for the majority of the week because I did not know what to make, but I was hovering around three different ideas.

An auto PB&J machine that would use motors and stuff to make me PB&J sandwiches whenever I want

A 3-chord organ using piezoelectric buzzers (I tried this before, and it wasn't as good)

A Jarvis workbench for my desk that could help me make things quicker (I saw one on TikTok, so I decided why not)

But after seeing how much time I was wasting just thinking about it, I decided to switch to the Starbie instead. But then I thought of another idea.

I wanted to make something using an ESP-CAM (Which I have experience with already)
And I wanted it to use an NFC Reader (which I have spare for some reason, along with a bunch of NFC Tags)
And I also wanted it to use one of those OLED screens the Starbie would have used.

So I decided to make an NFC Cyberdeck buddy that I could take around with me and take pictures of stuff while also being able to run special commands via NFC.

Since then ive just been gathering some materials I already have while also looking at PCB tutorials because im a complete beginner (I know pcb is just drawing circuits the professional way but im much more used to plugging in wires into a controller so it was definently a shift for me)

Here are some images below, and I'll keep everyone updated on my journey!
